items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: Peg or somebody had a band. Because they came out to the Orphering Theater lots of times.

ctx.x: Well, they had the Sweet Hearts of Rhythm.
Oh yeah. And then they had that other girl. Peg or somebody had a band. Because they came out to the Orphering Theater lots of times. All girls band. They were really good.

Yeah, they had some good ones. But, uh, well, there's one woman here at Lyon Bush I know that played drum golf. I think that's her name. She's down at, uh, Carl. Had the music. Had the music. You got energy enough to do another one? You got time enough?
